title: 天皇賞（春）の後に・“負けない”

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold City loses to Tamamo Cross and realizes how poorly she has been running up to now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today, for the first time, she experiences true frustration. She has been so concerned about the voices of those around her that she wasn't listening to her own heart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But now, she hears her heart scream with the pure desire to both run and win more.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The racecourse is where she wants to be, and her manager, moved to tears by the heartfelt joy she displayed on the track, agrees that she should continue racing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Next up is the Takarazuka Kinen, the final race of the Senior Spring Triple Crown and our chance to show Tamamo Cross what Gold City's really made of!
